<cite ref="Bava Kamma 27b:10">B. Kam. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>לב׳ חמש</he> for kicking with one’s foot &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 6:5">Men. VI, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 76a:1">76ᵃ</cite>) <he>שיפה וב׳ בחטין</he> rubbing and beating refer to the preparation of the wheat of the meat-offering (prior to grinding); R. Y. says <he>בבצק</he> (Mish. <cite ref="A02595"><he>אף</he></cite> incorr.) beating refers to the dough.
<cite ref="Menachot 76a:1">Ib.</cite> Var. <he>שיפה בחיטים וב׳ בבצק</he>; Tosef. ib. VIII, 14.
